Name: Letters and Shops Expanded
Author: GalaxyRobotMods
Description:
[center][b][color=#ff0000]Translators wanted!  any language is welcome.
[/color][/b][size=2]Thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Fdfvfrvcde/mods]Fdfvfrvcde[/url]﻿ for the Chinese translation
Thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/huntersoul5?gameId=1303]huntersoul[/url]﻿﻿ for the Portuguese translation.[/size]
[size=3]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/m0Lfzhm.png[/img]﻿[/size]
[/center][center][size=3]I made this mod with the purpose of making both the shops and the letter system more immersive.

[/size][size=3]This mod expands the shop inventory with permanent items and items you unlock during your playthrough. Here's a detailed list of everything the mod adds:[/size]

[color=#e06666][size=4][b]Marnie:[/b][/size][/color]
Auto-Petter[size=3]: Only when you reach 6 hearts with her will you receive a letter. 57500g[/size]
[b]Permanent Stock[/b]
[size=3]Brown and white eggs: 100g[/size]
[size=3]Milk: 250g
[/size]
[color=#783f04][size=4][b]Clint:[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]Geode Crusher: You'll receive a letter when you learn the recipe. 5000g[/size]

[color=#f6b26b][size=4]Robin:[/size][/color]
[size=3]Mini-Shipping Bin: When you get your first Mini-Shipping Bin, you'll be able to buy more from Robin, and you'll receive a letter. 500g
[b]Permanent Stock[/b]
Hardwood: 100g
Clay: 40g
All doors: 1000g (Perfect for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]PIF[/url]﻿)

[/size][color=#b6d7a8][size=4]Alex (Ice Cream Stand):[/size][/color]
[size=3][b]Permanent Stock[/b][/size]
[size=3]Cookies: 280g
Fruit Salad: 675g
Cranberry Candy: 270g

[/size][color=#ff7700][size=4]Pierre:[/size][/color]
[size=3]Tea tree: Only after learning the recipe. [/size]You'll receive a letter. [size=3]500 g[/size]
[size=3]Sprinklers (Normal and Quality): Upon reaching 5 friendship hearts, you'll receive a letter. 1250g and 5000g respectively.[/size]

[color=#674ea7][size=4]Krobus:[/size][/color]
[size=3]Teleportation Totems (Farm, Beach, and Mountain): Only after reaching 4 hearts with Krobus. You will receive a letter. [/size]2000g (farm), 1500g (mountain) [size=3]and 1000g (beach) [/size]
Artifact Trove[size=3]: Only available after reaching 4 hearts. Available only on Wednesdays. 1000g (only 1 for sale)[/size]
[size=3]Monster Musk: Only after learning the recipe. you [/size]will [size=3]receive a letter. 2500g[/size]

[color=#6aa84f][size=4]Raccoon:[/size][/color]
[size=3]Spring, Summer, Fall, and Winter Seeds: Only after feeding twice. Price is for 1 mixed seed.
Mixed Flower Seeds: Only after 2 feedings. Price is for 1 mixed seed.
Strawberry seeds: Only after feeding it 3 times. You will receive a letter (only in spring). The price is 5 Salmonberries.
A small collection of hats, such as the Daisy Hat, Forager's Hat, Panda Hat and Frog Hat in exchange for some fun items, such as sunflower seeds, honey, frog eggs or Horseradish
[/size]
[color=#ea9999][size=5]Any suggestions are welcome! ❤️[/size][/color]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/SWVYd8J.png[/img]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33906]Every Meal Matters[/url]﻿ Now every meal has some buff! Every meal matters like any other.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32607]Living Portraits[/url] A mod that adds backgrounds to portraits based on your location!﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17272]Seasonal Vanilla UI[/url] A mod that decorates the characters' UI according to the season and festival!
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16760]Seasonal Leaf Cursor[/url] A leaf-shaped cursor that changes with the season!﻿﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20837]Flowery and not blue grass[/url] Add flowers to the grass seasonally and turn blue grass into dark green grass.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26335]Difficult Bundles[/url] A mod that makes the community center difficult by modifying and adding bundles consistently.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30222]No more perfection for golden egg[/url] Now the traveling cart sells (very rarely) a golden egg. Highly configurable.﻿[/center]

Manifest.Name: (CP) Letters&Shops
Manifest.Description: Expands shop inventories across the valley with new items that unlock progressively as you befriend villagers. Get notified through in-game letters when new stock becomes available!
Manifest.Author: GalaxyRobot
